excerpted_medical_collections.name: Medical Excerpts
excerpted_medical_collections.observation: Physicians copy out the useful chapters of the old authorities into handy collections, and less is lost as the old books rot.

palace_physician_office.name: Chief Court Physician
palace_physician_office.observation: The ruler keeps a chief physician as a standing officer of the household, with healers under him.
palace_physician_office.ability_reason: The court's healing now has one keeper and one voice, and the best healers are drawn to the seat of rule.
palace_physician_office.social_consequence: Healers compete for the chief's favour; the palace physician decides who may treat the great.

ruled_hospital_staff.name: Hospital Rule
ruled_hospital_staff.observation: Hospital attendants serve under a master and a written rule of washing, feeding and watching the sick.

endowed_hospital_beds.name: Endowed Beds
endowed_hospital_beds.observation: Donors endow beds with a fixed allowance of bread, meat and clean linen; the beds are rarely empty, and fevers pass along the rows.

illustrated_herbals.name: Painted Herbals
illustrated_herbals.observation: Herbals are copied with painted plants, so a gatherer can match the leaf in the field and not pick its poisonous cousin.

bubo_plague_recognition.name: Swelling Plague Known
bubo_plague_recognition.observation: Healers tell the plague of swellings in groin and armpit apart from other pestilence, and the town knows sooner what has come.

quicklime_mass_graves.name: Limed Plague Pits
quicklime_mass_graves.observation: In great pestilence the dead go into long pits dressed with quicklime, layer by layer.
quicklime_mass_graves.social_consequence: Families lose the right to bury their own; the dead go unmourned into the lime.

plague_bedding_burning.name: Burning the Dead's Bedding
plague_bedding_burning.observation: The bedding and clothes of those who died of plague are burned in the street, though the poor weep to see good cloth go to the fire.

seaweed_goitre_remedy.name: Seaweed for Goitre
seaweed_goitre_remedy.observation: Burnt sponge and seaweed are given to those with swollen throats in the inland valleys, and the swellings shrink.

road_hostel_infirmaries.name: Road Hostel Infirmaries
road_hostel_infirmaries.observation: Hostels at the mountain passes keep a sick room for travellers, and what the travellers carry spreads through the hostel.

disease_causes_treatise.name: Treatise of Causes
disease_causes_treatise.observation: A great treatise lists every known disorder with its causes and signs, chapter by chapter.

medical_office_specialties.name: Court Medical Office
medical_office_specialties.observation: A court office divides healing into specialties, body, children, sores, bones and eyes, and runs a school that tests its pupils.
medical_office_specialties.ability_reason: Healing is taught by specialty and examined, so the court can post a trained physician wherever it needs one.
medical_office_specialties.social_consequence: The medical office ranks healers like officials; those outside it lose trust and custom.

uroscopy_flask.name: Urine Flask
uroscopy_flask.observation: The physician holds the patient's urine up in a clear flask and reads its colour, cloud and sediment, sometimes rightly.

practitioner_compendium.name: Practitioner's Compendium
practitioner_compendium.observation: A compendium in seven books gathers medicine, surgery and drugs for the working practitioner.

liver_night_blindness.name: Liver for Night Blindness
liver_night_blindness.observation: Those who cannot see at dusk are fed liver, and within days they find their way home in the evening again.

household_formulary.name: Household Formulary
household_formulary.observation: A book of a thousand remedies for common households lets families treat themselves, well or badly, without a physician.

licensed_drug_shops.name: Licensed Drug Shops
licensed_drug_shops.observation: Drug shops need the market warden's licence, and he inspects their jars and weights.

sickroom_diet_books.name: Sickroom Diets
sickroom_diet_books.observation: Diet books rank every food by its qualities and tell the sick what to eat and what to refuse.

cloister_infirmary.name: Cloister Infirmary
cloister_infirmary.observation: Religious communities keep an infirmary with its own herb garden, bath and piped water, apart from the main house.

ward_hospitals.name: Ward Hospitals
ward_hospitals.observation: Hospitals sort their sick into wards for fevers, wounds, eyes and the mad, with physicians on the staff and a pharmacy within.
ward_hospitals.ability_reason: The town's sick have a place to recover, not merely to die: fevers are kept from wounds and every ward has its physician.
ward_hospitals.social_consequence: The ward hospital is the largest building in town after the seat of rule, and its master answers to the founders' endowment.

travelling_dispensaries.name: Travelling Dispensaries
travelling_dispensaries.observation: Physicians travel with drugs on pack animals to villages and army camps that have no healer of their own.

bonesetting_treatise.name: Bone-Setting Treatise
bonesetting_treatise.observation: An illustrated treatise shows how each broken bone and dislocated joint is pulled, set and splinted.

hospital_formulary.name: Hospital Formulary
hospital_formulary.observation: The hospital pharmacy compounds only the drugs in its approved book, each by the same recipe.

sugar_syrup_remedies.name: Sugar Syrups
sugar_syrup_remedies.observation: Bitter drugs are made into syrups, electuaries and conserves with sugar, which keep well and are taken willingly.

eye_anatomy_treatise.name: Treatise on the Eye
eye_anatomy_treatise.observation: A treatise on the eye draws its coats, humours, lens and the nerves that run to the brain.

physician_conduct_book.name: Physician's Conduct
physician_conduct_book.observation: A book of the physician's duties teaches him to be sober, discreet, honest in his fees and never to give poison.

pox_measles_distinction.name: Pox and Measles Told Apart
pox_measles_distinction.observation: Physicians tell the two child-killing rashes apart by their course: the fever before, the rash after and the pits left behind.
pox_measles_distinction.ability_reason: Each pox is nursed and kept apart by its own rule, and fewer children die of the wrong treatment.

compared_treatment_groups.name: Compared Treatments
compared_treatment_groups.observation: A physician treats one group of patients one way and a second group another, and counts which recovered.

physician_licensing_exam.name: Physicians' Examination
physician_licensing_exam.observation: No one may practise physic until the examiners have questioned him and granted a licence.
physician_licensing_exam.ability_reason: The worst quacks are driven off, and a sick family can know that their physician has at least been examined.
physician_licensing_exam.social_consequence: Unlicensed wise-women and bone-setters now practise at risk of a fine, and much good folk skill is shut out with the quackery.

bedside_teaching.name: Bedside Teaching
bedside_teaching.observation: Hospital physicians walk their students from bed to bed, teaching from the patient rather than the book.

hospital_madness_wards.name: Madness Wards
hospital_madness_wards.observation: General hospitals keep a ward for the mad, with keepers, baths and music, instead of leaving them chained at home.

printed_state_pharmacopoeia.name: State Pharmacopoeia
printed_state_pharmacopoeia.observation: The state issues one book of approved drugs from carved blocks, and every district pharmacy works from the same page.

graded_cautery_irons.name: Cautery Irons
graded_cautery_irons.observation: Surgeons keep irons of different shapes, one for bleeding vessels, one for abscesses, one for wounds, and the burns are cruel.

illustrated_surgery_treatise.name: Illustrated Surgery
illustrated_surgery_treatise.observation: A surgery book draws each instrument and shows how each operation is done, step by step.
illustrated_surgery_treatise.ability_reason: Surgeons learn from drawn plates, not only a master's hands, and a skilled operation can be repeated in another town.

distilled_herb_waters.name: Distilled Waters
distilled_herb_waters.observation: Roses and herbs are distilled into fragrant waters for washing wounds and sickrooms and for drinking as remedies.

drug_adulteration_tests.name: Adulteration Tests
drug_adulteration_tests.observation: The market inspector tests drugs by weight, smell, fire and water, and burns the false ones in the square.

catgut_sutures.name: Gut Sutures
catgut_sutures.observation: Wounds and vessels are tied with thread of dried gut, which the body takes up instead of rotting around it.

canon_textbook.name: The Ordered Canon
canon_textbook.observation: One great textbook orders all of physic from cause to cure, and every school teaches from it.
canon_textbook.ability_reason: A student in any town now learns the same medicine, and a physician's training can be judged against one book.
canon_textbook.social_consequence: Its authority is such that doubting it becomes a fault, and its errors are taught as faithfully as its truths.

contact_contagion.name: Contact Contagion
contact_contagion.observation: Physicians teach that consumption and the itch pass by touch and shared bedding, and households keep the sick apart.
contact_contagion.social_consequence: The consumptive and the scabby are shunned, sometimes put out of doors by their own kin.

hollow_needle_cataract.name: Cataract Needle
hollow_needle_cataract.observation: A hollow needle draws out the clouded lens, and old craftsmen see well enough to work again.

needling_teaching_figures.name: Needling Figures
needling_teaching_figures.observation: Bronze figures pierced at every needling point are filled with water and coated in wax to test students.

state_drug_bureau.name: State Drug Bureau
state_drug_bureau.observation: State pharmacy offices sell standard drugs at fixed prices and give them free in epidemics.

burning_sickness_hospitals.name: Burning-Sickness Hospitals
burning_sickness_hospitals.observation: Houses are founded for those whose limbs blacken and burn; the sick sometimes mend there without knowing why.

nursing_brotherhoods.name: Nursing Brotherhoods
nursing_brotherhoods.observation: Sworn brotherhoods and sisterhoods run the hospitals of town and road, washing, feeding and turning the sick.
nursing_brotherhoods.ability_reason: The sick are nursed by people who have made it their calling, not by whoever the hospital can hire.
nursing_brotherhoods.social_consequence: The nursing orders become a power in the towns, holding endowments and answering to their own rule.

mercury_ointment.name: Quicksilver Ointment
mercury_ointment.observation: Quicksilver rubbed into the skin clears stubborn scabs and sores, though the patient drools, loses teeth and sometimes shakes for life.

household_health_verses.name: Health Verses
household_health_verses.observation: Rules of health for every season are set in verse that children learn and households repeat.

aged_almshouses.name: Almshouses
aged_almshouses.observation: Almshouses give the old and infirm a room, a fire and a daily allowance in return for their prayers.

itch_mite_removal.name: Itch Mite Removal
itch_mite_removal.observation: Women pick the tiny itch mite out of its burrow with a needle, and the itch heals once the mites are gone.

town_antidotary.name: Town Compound Book
town_antidotary.observation: Every apothecary in the town must compound by the same book, and the council's inspectors check the jars.

medical_faculty_licence.name: Medical Faculty Licence
medical_faculty_licence.observation: The medical faculty examines and licenses both teachers and practitioners, and its degree is accepted everywhere.
medical_faculty_licence.ability_reason: The degree becomes the physician's warrant in any town, and the teaching of medicine has a guild of its own.
medical_faculty_licence.social_consequence: Faculty men look down on surgeons and apothecaries, and women healers lose what standing they had.

bloodletting_calendars.name: Bleeding Calendars
bloodletting_calendars.observation: Bleeders consult a chart of the body's signs and the calendar's days before opening a vein, and bleed more often for having a rule.

spoiled_food_condemnation.name: Condemned Meat and Fish
spoiled_food_condemnation.observation: Market inspectors seize stinking meat and fish and burn them before the seller's stall.
spoiled_food_condemnation.social_consequence: Butchers and fishwives are fined and shamed in public; the market inspector becomes a feared town officer.

hospital_admission_books.name: Admission Books
hospital_admission_books.observation: Hospitals write down every admission, discharge and death, and the masters can see which wards lose the most.

apothecary_separation.name: Apothecaries Separated
apothecary_separation.observation: The law parts the physician from the apothecary: one prescribes, the other compounds, and drug prices are fixed.
apothecary_separation.ability_reason: Neither profits from the other's error, and a patient can have a prescription made up by a sworn apothecary at a fixed price.
apothecary_separation.social_consequence: Sworn apothecaries become town officers, with price schedules posted on the shop door.

pulmonary_transit.name: Blood Through the Lungs
pulmonary_transit.observation: A physician writes that the blood passes from the right side of the heart to the left through the lungs, not through the wall between.

inquest_handbook.name: Inquest Handbook
inquest_handbook.observation: Officials who view the dead follow a handbook of wounds, poisons, stranglings and drownings.
inquest_handbook.ability_reason: A hidden killing is now harder to pass off as fate, and deaths become matters of law.
inquest_handbook.social_consequence: An inquest officer is attached to the courts, and every sudden death brings him to the door.

blind_hospice.name: Hospice for the Blind
blind_hospice.observation: A hospice houses the blind poor, who beg in the streets by day under its badge and sleep there at night.

dry_wound_dressing.name: Dry Wound Dressing
dry_wound_dressing.observation: Surgeons wash wounds with wine and bind them dry, instead of coaxing pus with salves, and more wounds close clean.

leper_inspection_panels.name: Leper Panels
leper_inspection_panels.observation: A sworn panel examines anyone suspected of leprosy and sends those it condemns to the lazar house.
leper_inspection_panels.social_consequence: A panel's finding casts a person out of town and household alike, and some who are clean are cast out too.

reading_spectacles.name: Reading Spectacles
reading_spectacles.observation: Two ground lenses riveted in a frame let the long-sighted old read and sew again.
reading_spectacles.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Reading Spectacles from optical lenses, timber and refined copper, using stone and timber. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

street_filth_ordinances.name: Street Filth Ordinances
street_filth_ordinances.observation: Town ordinances forbid dung, offal and slops in the streets, and householders must sweep before their doors.

court_autopsy.name: Court Autopsy
court_autopsy.observation: When a death is disputed, the courts order a physician to open the body and report what he finds.

public_theriac_compounding.name: Public Great Antidote
public_theriac_compounding.observation: The great antidote of many ingredients is compounded in the square before the inspectors, so none can be left out.

surgeons_guild.name: Surgeons' Guild
surgeons_guild.observation: Surgeons form a guild with apprenticeship and a master's test, and barbers may no longer cut for the stone.

public_anatomy_dissection.name: Public Dissection
public_anatomy_dissection.observation: The body of a hanged felon is opened before students in a public hall, and the master shows what the books describe.
public_anatomy_dissection.ability_reason: What the old books say of the body can be checked against what lies on the table.
public_anatomy_dissection.social_consequence: Kin guard fresh graves, and the crowd at a public dissection is half learning and half spectacle.

walled_out_slaughter.name: Slaughter Outside the Walls
walled_out_slaughter.observation: Butchers must kill their beasts outside the town walls and downstream, and bring in only the dressed meat.

school_surgery_manual.name: Surgery Casebook
school_surgery_manual.observation: A surgery textbook of cases teaches school-trained surgeons what was done and what came of it.

plague_advice_tracts.name: Pestilence Tracts
plague_advice_tracts.observation: Short tracts tell households what to do in pestilence: fly early, keep fires, clean the house and shun the crowd.

pestilence_health_boards.name: Pestilence Health Boards
pestilence_health_boards.observation: In pestilence years a board of health takes power over the ordinary officials, closing markets, shutting infected houses and burying the dead.
pestilence_health_boards.ability_reason: The town fights the sickness as one body under one board, instead of every quarter shifting for itself.
pestilence_health_boards.social_consequence: Shut-in households starve behind barred doors; the board's orders are resented and evaded even as they save lives.

pestilence_gate_watch.name: Pestilence Gate Watch
pestilence_gate_watch.observation: In pestilence the gates are watched, cordons are drawn round sick districts and every traveller is questioned.
pestilence_gate_watch.social_consequence: Armed cordons turn back the hungry along with the sick, and trade halts while the watch stands.

pestilence_physicians.name: Pestilence Physicians
pestilence_physicians.observation: The town pays physicians to stay and treat the sick through the pestilence instead of fleeing with the rich.

arrival_isolation_period.name: Arrival Isolation
arrival_isolation_period.observation: Ships and travellers from a sick coast must wait thirty days apart before they may land or enter the town.
arrival_isolation_period.ability_reason: A pestilence must now outlast its carriers to reach the town, and a harbour isolation station stands off the quay.
arrival_isolation_period.social_consequence: Merchants curse the lost month, and bribes to shorten the wait are the harbour's commonest crime.
